summary: Cron heartbeat pre-spawn gating: 8/11 outer heartbeats across cron-cowork-team/cron-detect-loop/cron-standalone-team already gate the full subagent boot behind a deterministic shell pre-gate; code-janitor is the one concrete gap (post-boot in-flow gate skips only the DRY scan, 3 fully-deterministic sweeps still boot a full session unconditionally 4x/day, 10/10 last recorded cycles show the DRY-scan branch suppressed). Recommends mirroring the existing WU-1/2/3+CADRAT-2+market-db-journal-guard pre-spawn-shell-gate pattern for code-janitor only. Explicitly rejects introducing any LLM/local-model pre-gate anywhere in the 3 families (no fuzzy pre-spawn judgment case found; 3 documented live instances of safe-looking gates silently disabling their own mechanism, including one discovered this same session).
